snippet.title: Project Looking Glass | Indie Horror Game | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM TO MAKE ME SMILE
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4461730/Project_Looking_Glass/

A cold-war experiment has has opened a door it cannot close.

The year is 1963. A secret government agency runs a classified program called The Looking Glass — a technology that uses hemispheric synchronization waves to project a subject's consciousness into an astral plane, displayed on cathode monitors. You are Subject 7, a grieving woman recruited for your extraordinary ability to reach further than any subject before you.

Navigate the projections.

Explore surreal, sometimes peaceful, sometimes terrifying shifting dreamscapes rendered through the cathode glow of Cold War-era monitors. Every environment is a projection — of memory, of grief, of places that shouldn't exist. 

Uncover what happened.

Piece together the truth through recovered audio logs, memos, and feed recordings left behind in the astral plane. Solve the mystery of what happened to you as you live through it. 

Features:

A narrative-driven first-person psychological thriller set during the Cold War

Explore dreamlike projections through the lens of a retro CRT apparatus

Uncover the story through audio logs, memos, and environmental storytelling

A distinctive visual style blending lo-fi CRT effects, VHS glitching, and screen-locked textures

An original score and full voice acting

Localized subtitles in 11 languages

----

This is my second game as a solo indie dev. Warts and all, I hope you really enjoy! The only thing I try to do when making games, or art in general (I am primarily a musician and visual artist), is to try to make something that I myself like a lot. Felt compelled to tell this narrative. Hope you enjoy!

This game was inspired be games like:

P.T.

Stanley Parable

LSD Dream Simulator

Dreamcore

Subliminal

Petscop

My house.wad

Lucid Blocks
